#!/bin/sh
# difftest stub for bin/kith as kith-ask runs it: kith <agent> [opts] -- <task>, one JSON result (KITH_OUTPUT=json)
for last; do :; done
case "$last" in
  boom) echo "agent failed" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  errjson) printf '{"result":"it broke","is_error":true,"session_id":"s-err","total_cost_usd":0.02,"num_turns":2}\n' ;;
  park)
    # what kith-permit does when a card outlives its window: the ask that started the run is parked (the file today, the row once
    # the asks are the core's; the side that has no daemon ignores the call)
    machine=$(python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); from kith_paths import paths; print(paths()["KITH_MACHINE"])' "$ASK_K/lib")
    mkdir -p "$machine/live/ask"; : > "$machine/live/ask/$KITH_LAUNCH_ASK_ID.parked"
    if [ -n "${KITH_BIN:-}" ]; then
      printf '{"id":"%s","card":"c1"}' "$KITH_LAUNCH_ASK_ID" | "$KITH_BIN" kernel core-call ask.park --params-stdin >/dev/null 2>&1
    fi
    printf '{"result":"waiting","session_id":"s-park","total_cost_usd":0.01,"num_turns":1}\n' ;;
  *) printf '{"result":"answer to: %s","session_id":"s1","total_cost_usd":0.01,"num_turns":1}\n' "$last" ;;
esac
